scope: Feature-gated MOV CR3 effect consumption in MutableTranslationProbeSession; diagnostic one-entry cache only.

implementation.paging_profile: Long64 canonical48 physical36 four-level 4 KiB, CR0=0x80010033 CR4=0x20 EFER=0xd00

coverage: root A to root B clears cache synchronously; next lookup walks and following lookup hits
same-value CR3 write invalidates after PTE remap and write permission tightening
precise not-present and NX faults after root switch preserve retired MOV CR3
LOCK raises #UD; Ring3 access and reserved source bits raise #GP(0); state and resident entry remain unchanged
matching Ring0 fetch entry is warmed before PTE removal; exact fetch #PF leaves it intact
post-retirement reconciliation failures clear stale entry, poison session and block all further operations
pure instruction fetch and effect consumption do not write A/D or issue committed-write callbacks
limits: No production TLB or tracked A/D cache
No reset, CR0 or EFER transitions, huge pages, PCID/global semantics, JIT hooks, DMA or SMP
independent_review: gpt-6.1-sol/high: review findings fixed; final review has no remaining P0-P3 findings
